title: selliguea subfasciata
intro: Selliguea subfasciata, commonly known as the Sunda polypody or Sunda shield fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea subfasciata include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and act as an anti-allergic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
